dashboard.noLimitHint: Set a monthly limit or category budgets to see a daily allowance.
dashboard.coverageIncomplete: Some sources are missing the end of the month – import the next statement.
dashboard.backupDue: No backup in the last 30 days.

transactions.empty: No transactions for the selected month.
transactions.rememberRule: Remember category changes for the same merchant
transactions.ruleSaved: Rule for “{merchant}” saved. {count} more transactions changed.

import.fileLabel: Choose PDF statements (several at once is fine)
import.allAlreadyImported: All transactions from the selected files are already imported.
import.allAlreadyImportedNoIncome: No incoming payment (e.g. salary) was found in the PDF. Hard-refresh the page (Ctrl+Shift+R) to load the latest app, then import the same statement again.
import.previewHelp: You can change categories before importing.
import.help: Choose a PDF: an Erste card statement, a Revolut account statement or a Zagrebačka banka statement (Jedinstveni izvadak građana); the type is detected automatically. Card payments, cash withdrawals (Cash category), loan instalments (Loans), bills, fees, refunds and incoming payments such as salary (Income) are imported. Payments into Revolut Robo portfolio and the investment account are recorded as Savings & investments and are not counted as spending. Revolut top-ups, Erste card bill payments and similar transfers are skipped.

errors.empty: No transactions to import from this file.

pdf.noText: PDF has no text layer (scan). Import is not possible.
pdf.unknown: Unrecognised statement. Supported: Erste card statement, Revolut statement and Zagrebačka banka statement.

settings.monthlyLimitHint: Used only when no category limit is set on the Budget page.

rules.heading: Category rules
rules.help: One word or several separated by |, e.g. “bakery|cafe”. Your rules take priority over the built-in ones and are applied on import.

backup.heading: Backup
backup.help: Data only exists in this browser. Export a backup regularly and keep it somewhere safe (not in git).
backup.confirmRestore: Restoring deletes all current data and replaces it with the backup ({count} transactions). Continue?
backup.notPersisted: The browser did not grant persistent storage: data may be removed when browser data is cleared. Export backups.

errors.invalid: The file is not a valid backup.
errors.version: The backup comes from a newer app version.

budget.help: Monthly limit per category; empty means no limit. The sum of limits becomes the monthly limit. Fixed costs (e.g. loan instalments) are set aside up front, so the daily amount shows what is left for everything else.
